scene: The brass machine whirs, sliding open rear shutters to three waiting transports.
picture: Side view across the open stone balcony behind the lighthouse base. On the far left, a yellow hillside chairlift seat sways gently above a cliff path. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest and kite faces right. In the centre, a red sleigh tram sits ready. Far right, a striped hot-air balloon floats tethered.
shown: a swinging yellow chairlift seat dangling from a cable on the far left
a red runners-equipped sleigh tram waiting on tracks in the centre opening
a striped hot-air balloon basket tethered to a bollard on the far right
